description: Build FilterBar component with multi-select filters: sport, skill level, game type, fee range, player count. Save/load preferences from localStorage.
steps: Create components/games-hub/filter-bar.js: React component with local state for filters object

Render filter inputs: SportFilter (chips from SPORTS config), SkillLevelFilter (chips: all/beginner/intermediate/advanced/pro), GameTypeToggle (Free/Paid/Tournament), FeeRangeFilter (slider min-max), PlayerCountFilter (slider min-max)
Show active filter count indicator (badge: 'X active filters')
Implement 'Clear Filters' button to reset all
Debounce filter changes: 300ms before calling parent onFilterChange callback
localStorage: save filters to 'gamesHubFilters' on change, load on mount
Validate saved filters on load: check sport exists in SPORTS, skill level valid, show warning toast if removed filters
Responsive: horizontal chip scroll on mobile, grid layout on desktop
acceptance_criteria: FilterBar renders all filter types (sport, skill, type, fee, count)
Clear Filters button resets all to defaults
Saved filters persist across page reloads (localStorage)
Invalid saved filter removed with warning toast
Responsive layout verified on mobile and desktop
verification: Change sport filter to 'basketball', verify onFilterChange called after 300ms
Apply filters, reload page, verify filters persist
Remove basketball from SPORTS config, reload page, verify warning toast for removed sport
Resize to mobile, verify chip scroll layout
